title: RBS-Attention：面向长上下文大语言模型的半径约束稀疏预填充
summary: 提出RBS-Attention，一种免训练的稀疏预填充方法，通过质心基分支与救援分支的双分支选择缓解"均值稀释"问题。在H100上实现20.65倍独立预填充注意力加速、11.92倍vLLM加速，128K下端到端首token时间加速5.97倍，同时保持接近稠密注意力的质量。
summary_en: RBS-Attention is a training-free sparse-prefill method with dual selection branches: a centroid base branch and a rescue branch using max key-block radius to mitigate mean dilution. On H100 it achieves 20.65x standalone and 11.92x vLLM prefill-attention speedup, 5.97x end-to-end TTFT speedup at 128K, with near-dense quality.
